units.rawText: Professor, I don't wanna go to work today... I've come down with... Seasonal Laziness Syndrome... also known as the May Blues... Huh? The May Blues aren't a real illness?!

units.rawText: Seriously, I thought I'd found the perfect excuse to skip work... Come to think of it, the name doesn't even make sense! Nobody wants to work any day of the year, so why does only lazing around in May get a name?

units.rawText: If you ask me, every month of the year should have "don't-wanna-work days," twenty or more per month. The remaining workdays have to guarantee eight-hour shifts and two days off a week. That's the only way to maximize a unit's physical and mental health and relieve both the physical and mental fatigue that work causes.
